definitions.explanation: A self-service store selling food and household items. Short for スーパーマーケット.

examples.japanese: スーパー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought vegetables at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧スーパー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{開|あ}いています→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: This supermarket is open until 10 PM.
The supermarket is next to the station.

examples.japanese: スーパー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特売日|とくばいび}→特売日：27582_tokubaibi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You have to go early on supermarket sale days because there are many people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スーパー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Bento boxes get cheaper at the supermarket before closing time.

notes:
スーパー is the common abbreviation of ⟦スーパーマーケット→スーパーマーケット：27403_suupaamaaketto⟧ (supermarket). The full form is rarely used in conversation.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese supermarkets often discount prepared foods (⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧, ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧) in the evening before closing, typically marked with ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ stickers showing 20-50% off.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- スーパー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the supermarket
- スーパー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shop at the supermarket
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スーパー: the supermarket near the station
- スーパー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧: supermarket sale
